description: PostgreSQL 18 tsquery AST parsing, canonical output, boolean and phrase operators, prefix and weight matching, comparison, storage, and restart-safe equality
sql: CREATE TABLE type_matrix_tsquery (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, query TSQUERY NOT NULL UNIQUE);

INSERT INTO type_matrix_tsquery VALUES ('canonical', '!(fat | rat) & cat:*BA'), ('left-nested', '(a & b) & c'), ('right-nested', 'a & (b & c)'), ('weight-a', 'a:A'), ('empty', ''), ('operand-b', 'b'), ('not-a', '!a'), ('phrase-two', 'a <2> b'), ('phrase-one', 'a <-> b'), ('query-or', 'a | b'), ('query-and', 'a & b'), ('prefix-z', 'z:*A'), ('weight-y', 'y:B');
SELECT query AS canonical_query FROM type_matrix_tsquery WHERE id = 'canonical';
SELECT 'a'::tsquery && 'b'::tsquery AS query_and, 'a'::tsquery || 'b'::tsquery AS query_or, !!'a'::tsquery AS query_not;

SELECT '''a'':1A ''alpha'':2 ''b'':3B ''cat'':4C'::tsvector @@ 'a & b'::tsquery AS boolean_match, '''a'':1A ''alpha'':2 ''b'':3B ''cat'':4C'::tsvector @@ 'a <2> b'::tsquery AS phrase_match, 'al:*'::tsquery @@ '''alpha'':2'::tsvector AS reverse_prefix_match, '''a'':1A'::tsvector @@ 'a:B'::tsquery AS weight_mismatch, '''a'''::tsvector @@ 'a:B'::tsquery AS stripped_weight_match, '''a'''::tsvector @@ 'a <-> b'::tsquery AS stripped_phrase_match;
SELECT 'a:A'::tsquery = 'a:B'::tsquery AS weights_ignored, 'a:*'::tsquery = 'a'::tsquery AS prefix_ignored, 'a & (b & c)'::tsquery < '(a & b) & c'::tsquery AS tree_order;
SELECT id, query FROM type_matrix_tsquery WHERE id IN ('left-nested', 'right-nested') ORDER BY query;
SELECT id, query FROM type_matrix_tsquery WHERE id IN ('empty', 'weight-a', 'operand-b', 'not-a', 'phrase-two', 'phrase-one', 'query-or', 'query-and', 'prefix-z', 'weight-y') ORDER BY query;
